root_text: HMPV has zoonotic origins spilling over from an avian species centuries ago before it was discovered in the Netherlands in 2001. It is part of the same pneumoviridae family as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

nodes.author: Edourdoo
nodes.text: Like other respiratory viruses, HMPV can progress to more serious symptoms, including pneumonia, and poses elevated risk to young children, older adults and immunocompromised people.
